name: How do I choose the right water damage restoration company?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right water damage restoration company?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a restoration company, look for one that is certified by organizations like the IICRC (Institute of Inspection, Cleaning and Restoration Certification), available 24/7 for emergencies, and has positive customer reviews. Ensure they are licensed and insured, offer transparent pricing, and provide a clear plan of action. A reputable company will also assist with insurance claims documentation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a certified, 24/7 available, licensed, and insured company with good reviews. They should offer clear plans and help with insurance.
